meta.title: Chronic diarrhea with weight loss
meta.candidate_brief: You are the registrar in the gastroenterology clinic. Take a comprehensive history from this patient with chronic diarrhea and assess for red flags and impact.

patient_script.opening_statement: I've been running to the toilet with loose stools for months and I'm losing weight.

if_asked.symptom_details: I pass loose, sometimes watery stools about five times a day, occasionally with streaks of blood.
if_asked.timing: Started about eight months ago, slowly getting worse with flare-ups lasting days.
if_asked.after_effects: I feel exhausted and crampy afterwards.
if_asked.exacerbating: Stress and spicy food seem to trigger flares.
if_asked.relieving: Cutting dairy and resting help a bit, and loperamide slows it temporarily.
if_asked.associated_symptoms: I have crampy lower tummy pain, occasional mouth ulcers, joint aches, and night sweats. No vomiting.
if_asked.past_medical_history: I had iron deficiency anemia last year and eczema as a child.
if_asked.medications: Currently taking ferrous sulfate prescribed by GP and loperamide when needed.
if_asked.allergies: Allergic to shellfish; it causes hives.
if_asked.family_history: My older sister has ulcerative colitis. No colon cancer in the family.
if_asked.social_history: I don't smoke, I vape occasionally without nicotine, drink socially, work as a software developer mostly from home, and live with my partner.
if_asked.functional_status: I've had to work from home more and avoid eating out because I'm worried about needing a toilet quickly.

collateral.observer_note: Partner notes he wakes at night to use the toilet and seems more tired.

patient_script.emotional_tone: Tired but open, maintains eye contact

pc.one_liner: I've had ongoing loose stools for months and I'm dropping weight.

hpc.character: Loose watery stools with urgency and cramps
hpc.timing: Symptoms daily with intermittent flares lasting several days

sh.diet: Trying low FODMAP diet, reduced dairy
sh.occupation_detail: Remote software work with flexible hours

ice.ideas: Thinks it could be inflammatory bowel disease like his sister
ice.concerns: Worried about needing surgery or developing cancer
ice.expectations: Hopes for tests and a treatment plan to control symptoms

examiner_guidance.most_likely_diagnosis: Crohn's disease involving terminal ileum and colon
immediate_investigations: Blood tests including FBC, CRP, ferritin
